texts.zh:
虚境的浓雾颤抖着散去，露出一盏光洁无瑕的圣杯，里面盛满闪闪发光液体。

我们被莫名的冲动控制，不假思索地向前走。我们开始[GetDrinkLoc]起这杯期待着的液体，而它也开始颤抖起来。

一阵清醒涌上心头。我们[GetImbibeLoc]得越多，这个谎言便愈发昭显。液体开始变稠，一滴滴地在体内凝结。

我们被一种清除体内污秽的冲动征服。
texts.en:
The haze of the Shroud shudders, parting to reveal a chalice brimming with glistening liquid, its surface smooth and unbroken.

A compulsion grips us. We reach forward without thought. The expectant liquid trembles as we begin to [GetDrinkLoc].

Clarity floods through. The more we [GetImbibeLoc], the more the lie reveals itself. The fluid thickens, each drop beginning to curdle inside.

We are overcome with an urge to purge our systems of the contaminate.

texts.zh: 吞下吧！喝掉你的懦弱！
texts.en: GORGE! DROWN YOUR WEAKNESS!

texts.zh: 咽下吧！吸入新的成长！
texts.en: NOURISH! INHALE NEW GROWTHS!

texts.zh: 变强吧！接纳痛苦的联合！
texts.en: STRENGTHEN! EMBRACE PAINFUL UNIFICATION!

texts.zh: 放纵吧！沉溺于你的嗜好！
texts.en: IMBIBE! INDULGE YOUR ADDICTIONS!

texts.zh: 这声音飞旋着与液体融合，在体内不断凝结，让我们屈服于祂的意志。
texts.en: The voice swirls, mixing with the liquid, congealing as it forces its way further inside us, bending our submission to its will.

texts.zh:
最后一滴液体被咽下，它粘稠得令人作呕，在体内积聚，饱和着我们的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]。

一股暖流涌上全身，扭曲着我们的思想，磨损了[GetPsycheLoc]的边缘。

那个声音带着满足归来，圣杯在我们面前消融。
texts.en:
The last of the liquid sloughs down, thick and repugnant. Pooling within us, saturating our [GetMindPhysicalLoc].

Heat pulsates through us, warping our thoughts, fraying the edges of our [GetPsycheLoc].

The voice returns, satisfied, as the chalice dissolves before us.

texts.en: INTEGRATOR! MINDS UPON MINDS.

texts.zh: 颓废之人！去探索感官吧。
texts.en: DECADENCE! SENSES TO EXPLORE.

texts.zh:
我们拒绝遭到玷污，剧烈的抽搐撕裂了我们的[GetBodiesLoc]，由内而外清除了令人作呕的物质。

邪恶的液体溅落到虚空上，扭动着散开去。那心声嘶嘶作响，它的话语随着污物一起蒸发了。
texts.en:
Violent convulsions wrack our [GetBodiesLoc] as we reject the contamination, purging the cloying substance from within.

The vile liquid splatters against the void, writhing as it disperses. The voice hisses, its words evaporating along with the filth.

texts.en: SUCH POTENTIAL...
